name: Terah
bio: Terah is the father of Abram (Abraham), Nahor, and Haran, and grandfather of Lot. He set out with Abram, Lot, and his daughter-in-law Sarai from Ur, intending to go to Canaan, but settled instead in Haran, where he died at 205 years old without ever reaching the promised land himself (Genesis 11:27-32). Though Terah never completed the journey, he stands at the starting point of the migration story that leads directly into God's call of Abram and the opening of a new chapter in redemptive history.
